"""Complete unchanged exploratory cases in processes; never measure durations."""
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor, as_completed
from multiprocessing import get_context
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,sys

REPO=Path('/Users/schnee/Documents/Codex/files-mentioned-by-the-user-thesis/jordan-sorting')
SCRATCH=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(REPO/'experiments'))
import probe_geometric_inputs as probe


def evaluate_fixed(arguments):
    return probe.evaluate(*arguments)


def main():
    prefix=SCRATCH/'serial_prefix.json.partial'
    saved=prefix.read_text()
    header,body=saved.split('  "cases": [\n',1)
    payload=json.loads(header.rstrip().removesuffix(',')+'\n}')
    cases=[]
    unfinished_fragment=None
    for line in body.splitlines():
        if not line.strip():continue
        try:cases.append(json.loads(line.rstrip(',')))
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            unfinished_fragment=line
            break
    assert payload['source_sha256']==probe.source_snapshot()
    plan=[(size,index,probe.case_seed(20261101,size,index),16)
          for size in probe.SIZES for index in range(20)]
    for expected,case in zip(plan,cases):
        assert (case['target_n'],case['index'],case['seed'])==expected[:3]
    assert len(cases)<100
    pending=plan[len(cases):]
    interrupted=pending[0]
    notes=dict(mode='unchanged per-input calls; saved serial prefix then independent worker processes',
               worker_processes=4,completed_serial_prefix=len(cases),
               interrupted_case=f'geometric-n{interrupted[0]}-{interrupted[1]:02d}',
               interruption_reason='controlled stop to move remaining fixed checks to independent processes; no outcome-based filtering',
               incomplete_attempt_is_not_an_oracle_rejection=True,
               same_seed_reused_for_interrupted_case=True,other_completed_cases_rerun=False,
               serial_prefix_sha256=hashlib.sha256(prefix.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
               serial_prefix_path=str(prefix),incomplete_record_fragment_preserved=unfinished_fragment is not None,
               continuation_source_path=str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
               continuation_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
               continuation_source=Path(__file__).read_text())
    with (SCRATCH/'parallel_records.jsonl').open('x') as stream:
        with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=4,mp_context=get_context('spawn')) as pool:
            futures={pool.submit(evaluate_fixed,item):item for item in pending}
            for future in as_completed(futures):
                item=futures[future]
                try:case=future.result()
                except Exception as exc:
                    case=dict(case=f'geometric-n{item[0]}-{item[1]:02d}',target_n=item[0],index=item[1],seed=item[2],
                              status='checked_error',error=dict(type=type(exc).__name__,message=str(exc)))
                stream.write(json.dumps(case,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n');stream.flush()
                cases.append(case)
                print(f"{len(cases)}/100: {case['case']} {case['status']}",flush=True)
    payload['cases']=sorted(cases,key=lambda case:(case['target_n'],case['index']))
    payload['execution']=notes
    payload['summary']=probe.summarize(payload['cases'])
    payload['source_unchanged']=payload['source_sha256']==probe.source_snapshot()
    payload['complete']=len(cases)==100
    assert payload['source_unchanged'] and payload['complete']
    raw=REPO/'docs/development/geometric_generator_probe_20261101.json'
    report=REPO/'docs/development/geometric_generator_probe_20261101.md'
    with raw.open('x') as stream:
        header={k:v for k,v in payload.items() if k!='cases'}
        stream.write(json.dumps(header,indent=2)[:-2]+',\n  "cases": [\n')
        stream.write(',\n'.join(json.dumps(case,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')) for case in payload['cases']))
        stream.write('\n  ]\n}\n')
    probe.write_report(report,raw,payload)
    return all(case['status']=='pass' for case in cases)


if __name__=='__main__':
    raise SystemExit(0 if main() else 2)
